system.perspective.print("getPerfEvents() called")

	selection = self.view.custom.shiftProductionEvents.selection.data
	filter = self.view.custom.filter

	if len(selection) > 0:
		selection = selection[0]
		assetPath = selection['assetPath']
		modeEventId = selection['modeEventId']
		startDate = system.date.fromMillis(selection['millisStart'])
		endDate = system.date.fromMillis(selection['millisEnd'])
	else:
		if (filter['assetPath'] or None) is None: return []
		assetPath = filter['assetPath'] + '%'
		startDate = filter['startDate']
		endDate = filter['endDate']
		modeEventId = None
	
	if assetPath is None: return []
	
	paramsDict = {'assetPath': assetPath, 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'modeEventId': modeEventId}
	self.view.custom.performanceEvents.data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.event.getPerformanceEvents(paramsDict))

	return
